title: Enshrouded

verdict.summary: Enshrouded launched its 1.0 version on PC and PS5 without crossplay, so PC and PS5 players can only share worlds with people on the same platform.

notes: Version 1.0 came out on October 15, 2026 on Steam and PS5. Keen Games said in its launch FAQ that the game would not be cross-platform at launch, that it is working on cross-platform play, and that it has no estimate for when it will arrive.
PC worlds hold up to 16 players. On PS5, online co-op supports up to 8 players and needs PS Plus.
An Xbox Series X|S version is planned for spring 2027. No crossplay with Xbox has been announced.

title: Dying Light 2: Stay Human
notes: The only crossplay is on PC, where Steam and Epic Games Store players can play co-op together.
There's no crossplay between PlayStation, Xbox and PC. Cross-generation co-op does work: PS4 with PS5, and Xbox One with Xbox Series X|S.
Techland's support page says save transfer between platforms isn't possible either. The studio has called full cross-platform co-op a complex technical challenge and hasn't announced it.
progress: Saves can't be moved between PC, PlayStation and Xbox.

verify.what: Techland support page (Steam+Epic together, cross-gen only, no cross-platform co-op or save transfer) matches; no 2025-26 crossplay change found.

title: Vigor
notes: Console crossplay arrived with the Season 21 Bloodline update in December 2024, putting PlayStation, Xbox and Switch players in the same matches for the first time. Xbox One and Xbox Series X|S also play together (the Xbox store lists cross-gen multiplayer).

PC (Steam) players have their own pool. When the free PC release launched in September 2024, Bohemia said there was no crossplay yet but that it planned to add it with an on/off option; no PC crossplay has been announced since.
Bohemia ended Switch support in 2025: Meltdown (April 2025) was the last Switch season and the game stopped working on Switch when it ended. Later seasons list only Xbox, PlayStation and Steam.
There's no cross-progression: Bohemia said it doesn't plan to add it.

title: Sackboy: A Big Adventure
notes: Online co-op for up to 4 players was added in December 2020 with PS4/PS5 cross-play, so PS4 and PS5 owners can play together. Online play on PlayStation needs PS Plus.
The PC version (Steam and Epic, October 2022) has its own online co-op. There's no crossplay between PC and PlayStation.
Press reports say Steam and Epic players can join each other on PC, and that joining a friend who uses an Epic account may ask you to link one too. Sony and Sumo haven't spelled this out officially.
progress: PS4 progress can be moved to PS5 from the Extras menu in the PS4 version; there's no shared progress with PC.

title: Deadzone: Rogue
notes: Full crossplay between PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S started with the console launch on September 3, 2025. Nintendo Switch 2 joined the crossplay pool in update 1.2.0.0 in March 2026.
Co-op squads are up to 3 players. If one platform's patch is behind, crossplay with that platform can drop out until it catches up.
There's no cross-progression. A separate sequel, Deadzone Rogue 2, has a crossplay demo on PC, PS5 and Xbox.
progress: Progress stays on each platform; the developer said it didn't expect to offer cross-progression.

title: Cult of the Lamb

verdict.summary: Cult of the Lamb has no crossplay because its co-op is local only: a second player joins as the Goat on the same screen.

notes: The free Unholy Alliance update (August 2024) added two-player local co-op on every platform. There's no online co-op, and the developers said they had no plans to bring co-op online.
On Steam, friends can play together online through Remote Play Together, where only the host needs the game. This only works between Steam users.
The Woolhaven expansion (January 2026) and the Switch 2 version (October 22, 2026, a free upgrade for Switch owners) didn't change this.

title: Infinity Nikki
notes: Two-player online co-op arrived in Version 1.5 on April 29, 2025, the same day the game came to Steam. It started on a dedicated multiplayer map and is optional. Infold says the game supports cross-platform play across PS5, PC and mobile, and its Steam page lists cross-platform multiplayer.
Friends are tied to a server region: Infold says Steam players can connect with friends on the same server, just like players on other platforms.
Progress is tied to your Infold account, so you can carry on between PC, PS5 and mobile; Steam players link an existing account by email when they log in.
progress: Log in with the same Infold account on any platform to keep your progress.

title: Active Matter
notes: Active Matter launched on September 15, 2026 on Steam, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, plus the Gaijin Store on PC, with cross-platform multiplayer. The PC version also runs natively on Linux and Steam Deck.
Console players can choose who they're matched with: their own platform only, consoles only, or all platforms.

Progress is shared only between the Steam and Gaijin.Net versions on PC. The FAQ says it can't be moved between PC and consoles (a generic line in the site's purchase pop-up says otherwise, but the FAQ answers the question directly).
progress: Link your Gaijin and Steam accounts to share progress on PC (early Gaijin Store buyers must link by November 23, 2026 to get the Steam copy); there's no transfer to or from consoles.
toggle: On consoles, pick the matchmaking pool: your platform only, consoles only, or any platform.

title: Halloween: The Game
notes: The game launched on September 8, 2026 on PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam and Epic) with crossplay across all platforms for its 1v4 multiplayer.

Your normal friends list only shows people on your own platform. To party up across platforms, share the friend code from the second (Crossplay) tab of the Friends menu. Patch 1.0.1 fixed cross-play parties being split up during matchmaking.
There's no cross-progression: unlocks and player level stay on the platform where you earned them.
progress: Progress and unlocks stay on each platform.

title: Euro Truck Simulator 2

verdict.summary: Euro Truck Simulator 2 is only on computers for now, so there's no console crossplay; the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions don't have a release date yet.

notes: The built-in Convoy multiplayer mode (since update 1.41 in July 2021) lets up to 8 players drive together in private sessions on Steam. Everyone needs the latest game version, but you don't need the same map DLCs (you just can't drive in areas you don't own).
The game runs on Windows, Mac and Linux, and Convoy is available on all three. We haven't found an official statement on whether players on different operating systems can join the same session.
SCS is still working on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions. A playable PS5 build was shown at Tokyo Game Show in September 2026, but no release date or console crossplay plans have been announced.
